epics.title: Academic Entity Relationship Knowledge Graph & Profile Cards
epics.jtbd: When an educational administrator, department head, or supervisor manages academic workflows, I want an entity relationship graph connecting postgraduates, residents, applicants, academic supervisors, departments, commissions, and their official documents, so that academic profiles, institutional hierarchy, and document provenance are transparently organized and navigable.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Domain fidelity rate >= 99.9% and zero unhandled auth/validation boundary failures
epics.tocConstraintRef: Frontend CRIE domain entity rendering and auth error boundary fidelity
requirements: R1: Eliminate synthetic FinTech placeholders in UI mockups and frontend components, replacing them with authentic FBUN CRIE epidemiological knowledge base domain models, residency/aspirantura curricula, 1697 regulatory documents, and decree generation workflows.

R2: Implement explicit auth/validation boundaries and negative error states (HTTP 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Forbidden) with visible error feedback and resilient input preservation across academic graph and profile navigation.

slices.title: Patch CRIE Academic Entity UI and Auth Validation Error Boundaries
slices.jtbd: When implementing authentic domain entity rendering and error handling for this epic, I want to replace synthetic FinTech artifacts with genuine CRIE academic entities and enforce 400/401/403 boundary handling, so that academic profiles, institutional hierarchy, and document provenance are transparently organized and navigable with complete ontological fidelity.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an authenticated educational administrator or supervisor accessing the CRIE knowledge base and academic entity graph
When the user queries academic profiles, residency/aspirantura curricula, or document provenance across the 1697 regulatory corpus
Then the UI strictly renders authentic CRIE domain entities without synthetic FinTech placeholders, displaying valid department nodes, supervisor linkages, and GOST decree generation controls.
Given an unauthenticated request or invalid perimeter token/PIN (152-FZ security perimeter)
When the client attempts to access protected academic graph endpoints or profile cards
Then the system rejects the request with HTTP 401 Unauthorized, returning a structured error message and blocking access to academic records.
Given an authenticated user lacking administrative privileges attempting unauthorized modification of academic records
When an entity relationship update or restricted dossier request is submitted
Then the system refuses the operation with HTTP 403 Forbidden, logging the security event without leaking internal identifiers.
Given malformed request parameters or invalid entity graph filters
When the client submits the search or document generation request
Then the system responds with HTTP 400 Bad Request, displaying immediate inline validation feedback and preserving all user-entered form data without data loss.
slices.tocConstraintRef: UI domain entity model fidelity and negative error state presentation
slices.sixSigmaMetric: 100% replacement of FinTech stubs with CRIE entities and 100% coverage of 400/401/403 boundary conditions
